note: XXII cue 94 B1 (Wright of Derby): Van Helsing came bearded; he is never bearded.

people.vh: Professor Van Helsing, elderly, completely clean-shaven, round dark spectacles

beats.text: Remove the beard and moustache from the kneeling elderly man with spectacles so his chin, jaw and upper lip are completely clean-shaven, like the reference portrait. Keep his face, spectacles, pose, coat, the lantern light and everything else in the painting exactly as it is.
